# Paper Insight Instructions

Apply this file only when creating or materially updating a paper-insight page.
Other docs pages follow their own page type and the front matter rules in
[docs-front-matter.instructions.md](docs-front-matter.instructions.md).
The broad path match cannot distinguish paper insights from other docs; this
page-type condition controls which references to read.

Read the references that govern the work:

- [Opening and core idea](references/paper-opening.md): cognitive principles,
  paper header, TL;DR, Big Picture, Why This Exists, Landscape, Core Idea.
- [Mechanism and runtime trace](references/paper-mechanism.md): notation,
  Deep Dive, Putting It Together.
- [Results and closing](references/paper-results.md): claims, failure modes,
  takeaway, Go Deeper.
- [Choosing representations](references/paper-representations.md): working
  notes, callouts, comparison tables, related-page maintenance.
- [Figures and diagrams](references/paper-visuals.md): source figures,
  synthesized visuals, captions, accessibility, editable files.
- [Style and review](references/paper-review.md): page style, self-test,
  confidence boundary, exceptions.

For a complete new paper insight, read all six references before drafting.
For a targeted edit, read the affected references and the style and review
reference. Preserve the section order unless its stated exception applies.
